title: Keyturn Roadside Assistance Charge Schedule: Excess, Additional Callouts and Abortive Callouts
content:
## Money charged on a Keyturn Roadside Assistance callout

The excess is the amount the member pays toward each callout. The additional callout price is what a
callout costs once the included allowance is used. The cancellation fee is charged for calling off a
callout after the operator has set out, and the no-show fee where nobody is with the vehicle when the
operator arrives.

| Plan | Excess toward each callout (USD) | A callout once the allowance is used (USD) | Calling off after the operator has set out (USD) | Nobody with the vehicle on arrival (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover | 25.00 | 95.00 | 25.00 | 45.00 |
| Keyturn Roadside Plus Cover | 15.00 | 85.00 | 20.00 | 45.00 |
| Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover | 0.00 | 75.00 | 20.00 | 40.00 |
| Keyturn Roadside EV Cover | 0.00 | 89.00 | 25.00 | 50.00 |
| Keyturn Roadside Fleet Cover | 0.00 | 65.00 | 15.00 | 35.00 |
| Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover | 0.00 | 55.00 | 0.00 | 25.00 |

### Notes on the schedule

1. An excess is carried by Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover at USD 25.00 and by Keyturn Roadside Plus
   Cover at USD 15.00. On Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover, Keyturn Roadside EV Cover, Keyturn Roadside
   Fleet Cover and Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover the excess stands at USD 0.00.
2. The price of a callout beyond the allowance does not fall evenly down the schedule: it stands at
   USD 95.00 on Keyturn Roadside Basic Cover, USD 85.00 on Keyturn Roadside Plus Cover, USD 75.00 on
   Keyturn Roadside Tow Cover, USD 89.00 on Keyturn Roadside EV Cover, USD 65.00 on Keyturn Roadside
   Fleet Cover and USD 55.00 on Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover.
3. Keyturn Roadside Concierge Cover carries no charge for calling off a callout, its figure standing
   at USD 0.00, and the lowest no-show figure at USD 25.00; the highest no-show figure, USD 50.00, is
   carried by Keyturn Roadside EV Cover.
